parameters: A shard of black crystal, half sunk in the earth.
The grass around it is not withered. It is dead - every blade, in a ring.
It is the same dark crystal as the ones from the shrine in the wood.
A strip of dark cloth caught on the thorns. Good cloth - not a woodsman's.
Someone came this way, and did not want to be seen doing it.
An old way-shrine. The crystal in it still glows, faintly,
as if it has been waiting.
